in_marathi.name: Eeshansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eeshansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eeshansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the name of Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration. The name is a combination of two words: 'Eesha' meaning 'God' and 'Ansh' meaning 'Form' or 'Symbol'. This name symbolizes the divine form of Shiva, who is believed to be the embodiment of consciousness and creation.
